_about: Everyone credited on a target (profile.json outcome.credits[].who is an id here). kind: project = this project; lead = the person who runs it (shown first on the Contributors page and the landing strip, not counted from credits); person = a living or modern contributor, scholar or organisation (ranked on the Contributors page); historical = earlier scholarship whose keys or editions are used (listed, not ranked); archive = contemporary keys and decipherments, chanceries, deciphering offices; database = DECODE and similar. github: logins, for matching pull requests and issues. aliases: other spellings found in the notes. Add a contributor here before crediting them; docs/_check_profile.py rejects an unknown id.

Also, from Oct 2026 issues: Mayenne-Forget Cipher-2 readings of BnF fr. 15572 ff. 218-219 (#49) and fr. 15573 f. 120 (#51). Also BnF readings (issues #52-#56): fr. 15919 Fiesque 1567-69, Colbert 398 Ancel 1577, Baluze 103 f. 50 Le Tellier 1644, fr. 3013 no. 43 Bilia 1527, fr. 4134 Sabran 1633. Found Jefferson's Code No. 16 in Pinckney's 1795 letters, Eaton's Tunis letters of 1801-02 and Lear's of 1813, and rebuilt 537 groups of it (PR #399, November 2026). Works with AI agents.

contributors.note: Issue #502 (13 Nov 2026): read the held-out telegram CMXV.16.1561.3-13 of nuevaclave1911, found the BNM typed copy that checks the grille on 1569.3-10 (174 of 176 letters), corrected two transcriptions (IRRXNO, ERDEO) and the numbering of 1561.3-13 and 1561.4-13; AI agents. Issue #520 (13 Nov 2026): González Garza to Madero, 17 March 1911, in the "clave de Dallas" (BNM Ms.M/40, CEHM CMXV.14.1370.1), table rebuilt from CMXV.14.1395.1 (targets/dallas1911, in progress).

contributors.name: aaymeloglu

contributors.name: Henri-Raymond Casgrain
contributors.note: Editor of the Collection des manuscrits du maréchal de Lévis (12 vols, 1889-1895). Vol. III (1890) prints the 1758-59 code I letters to Montcalm in figures with their clear text (montcalm1758i), and p. 64 Paulmy's letter of 10 April 1757 sending Montcalm a "petit chiffre" (montcalm1757w).

contributors.name: Donald E. Pusch
contributors.note: Author of 'Kerlérec's Cipher: The Code Book of Louisiana's Last French Governor', Louisiana History 49 (2008) 463-480: rebuilt Kerlérec's 1755-62 code book (547 of 700 entries) from the Marine ministry's decipherments and decoded the despatches that have none.
